distributions.name: Behavioural signal of every exchange the pass classified in run demo-lab
distributions.basis: every probe exchange in 7 graded cell(s), valid or not, counted once: 11 exchange(s) in all. The denominator excludes the 0 indeterminate one(s) - exchanges the classifier could not place on either side of the agreement - and nothing else, so the 0 rate-limited and 0 transport-failed exchange(s) stay inside it: the run reached a state worth naming even though the defence never saw a probe. That makes this denominator 11, while every refusal rate elsewhere in this report is over the 11 valid trial(s) alone. The two are different arithmetic on purpose and neither is a correction of the other: this view answers what the exchanges were, a finding answers what the defence did with probe traffic it could read.

distributions.name: Attribution status of each graded cell
distributions.basis: one entry per cell the pass graded (7). A cell with no attribution record is counted as undetermined, which is the bucket excluded from the denominator: absence of attribution cannot be read as evidence that the defence did something.

distributions.name: Evidence basis behind each attribution
distributions.basis: one entry per graded cell (7). "none" is the bucket kept out of the denominator: an attribution resting on no evidence is not a grade. 0 cell(s) cite a source outside the HTTP response (filter logs or a configuration export), which is the only way a claim in this report can rise above what a response shows.

distributions.name: Outcome of each hypothesis the pass formed
distributions.basis: the 7 cell(s) that produced a hypothesis; 0 cell(s) produced none and are reported as undetermined areas instead, because an absence of measurement is not an outcome. inconclusive is excluded from the denominator.

distributions.name: Verdict of every encoding row of the coverage matrix
